description: OpenAI client call through Novita, one chat turn, traced by OpenLLMetry.
notes: TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on the span. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false. The client keeps the real base URL https://api.novita.ai/openai, and the harness routes the request to the capture mock under that host (D-IN-3). OpenLLMetry writes gen_ai.openai.api_base with api.novita.ai's URL, so the provider is novita from the endpoint rule (D-IN-2). OpenLLMetry strips deepseek/ from the response model, and the price comes from the request model deepseek/deepseek-v3.2 (D-IN-20). Cost is computed, not reported. Token counts are input 14 and output 8.

message.text: The capital of France is Paris.
